Legend ● Blue: Thư-specific ● Teal: all users ● Indigo: Đức Anh-specific ● Gray: system-supported «include» = always part of · «extend» = optional extension · ▷ = generalization
Sequence Diagram — Scan whiteboard → searchable note → find it later
Scenario of persona Thư in class; offline-first save, background sync, on-device OCR + search index.
User Flow — main tasks (Capture · Find · Tasks)
Rounded = screen / action, diamond = decision, pill = start / end.
Interaction Diagram — Norman’s 7 stages of action applied to a real task
Task: “Remind me to collect Minh’s tuition fee tonight” (persona Thư). Shows how the UI bridges the Gulf of Execution and the Gulf of Evaluation.
GOAL Never forget who has paid the tuition
1 · Intention “Add a reminder to the fee item”
2 · Action specification Open note → tap bell next to ☐ “Thu học phí Minh” → pick “This Evening 18:00”
3 · Execution Tap · tap · tap (3 taps, 44 pt targets, thumb zone)
5 · Perception Sees orange “Today 18:00” label + bell icon on the item; toast “Reminder set”
6 · Interpretation “The reminder is attached to this exact task”
7 · Evaluation Goal met? Item also appears in Tasks › Today ✓
4 · SYSTEM / WORLD — Opportunities app stores reminder, schedules iOS notification, updates Tasks view, syncs

Design bridges: • Bell button sits right next to the checklist item (mapping) • Quick picks: This Evening / Tomorrow / Before Next Class (recognition over recall) • Same pattern everywhere — Apple sheet & toggles (consistency) • Large targets, one-hand reach (Fitts’s law)

Design bridges: • Immediate feedback: toast + orange due label (complementary accent) • System status always visible: “Saved · Synced” badge • Result visible in a second place (Tasks › Today) • Undo available — errors are reversible
Direct manipulation drag scan corners, tick checkboxes, swipe to delete
Menus & sheets Quick Capture sheet, share sheet, ⋯ menu
Form-fill reminder details, tuition table cells (auto =SUM)
Natural language / voice search “tích phân”, dictate notes on the bus
Command language Markdown / LaTeX, ⌘K palette for power users
Customer Journey Map — Trần Minh Thư (student & freelance tutor)
Scenario: one week of lectures, tutoring and exam revision — before vs. with Opportunities.
Hears about app from classmates; looks for one place for notes
Installs, picks “Simple” style, imports old notes
Types lecture, scans whiteboard, dictates idea on bus
Files notes into subject folders, adds #tags
Searches keyword the night before exam
Sends read-only link to group via Zalo
Phone reset / weak Wi-Fi — notes still there
Whiteboard photos buried; typing formulas slow
Can’t search inside photos; loses time
Lost notes to phone reset; cloud-only fails offline
One app for text, checklist, scan, voice
Style choice; Live Preview hides syntax
One-tap capture, edge detection, OCR, math palette
Folders per subject, smart filters, nested tags
Inline reminders + Tasks view + tuition template
3 tabs + always-available Quick Capture (+) and Search; Settings from the ⋯ menu. Max depth = 3 taps.
Filter chips (Lecture, Tutoring, Project, Chưa xong)
Smart lists: Today / Scheduled / All / Overdue
Smart folders (Chưa xong, Has reminder, Scans)
Scopes: All / Notes / Photos & Handwriting / Tasks

Hierarchical Task Analysis (HTA) — Phân tích tác vụ phân cấp
Goal 0 decomposed into sub-tasks; plans describe order and conditions (Annett & Duncan notation).
0. Manage study & tutoring notes in one place
Plan 0: do 1 whenever information appears → 2 right after capture (optional) → 3 before lessons / exams → 4 daily → 5 when collaborating
Plan 1.3.2: 1 → 2 (if edges not found, drag corners) → 3 → 4 only if text wrong.
Plan 1: 1 → 2 → 3 → 4. At 3 choose ONE: in class → 1.3.2; on the bus → 1.3.3; otherwise 1.3.1.
Plan 2: 2.1 always (default Inbox); 2.2–2.4 optional, in any order.
Plan 3: 1 → 2; if > 5 results do 3; then 4. Repeat 2–4 until found.
Plan 4: 1 → 2 when creating; 3 every morning; 4 when finished or from the notification.
Plan 5: 1 → 2 → 3 when sharing; 4 is automatic — verify before exams.
